WELL WORTHY OF 5 STARS
Jan 2024 • Couples
First saw this place when we were with friends at the ice cream parlour opposite. It looked a lovely new restaurant and decided I would look it up on the website when back at our apartment. 

As it had only been open a little while I could not find a menu to view online so directly messaged the restaurant and asked for a link. This request was immediately done which I was very impressed with. The menu looked varied and as it was newly opened they were offering a 20% discount off the total bill which made it even more appealing. Although the prices were very reasonable anyway for this standard of dining. 

As foodies our expectations were high as we walked the short distance to the restaurant. We were met by the manager who I had been in conversation with earlier via messenger and he had reserved us a lovely table. Menus were presented in tablet form and were extensive along with the wine list. 

My husband chose Chicken Wings Korean Style as an appetiser and then we both settled for a steak (Topblade) and Striploin with a Pepper Sauce on each plate. The mains listed accompanied by vegetables but we also chose a side of fries and garlic mushrooms. 

The Chicken Wings arrived and they were huge. Easily enough for 2 pax but this was not the intention as my husband is on a protein rich diet. He said they were delicious and soon finished them off! We asked for an accompanying water dip bowl to clean fingers afterwards. I should also mention that the wine we chose was delivered to the table on a professional way and poured to taste first. Excellent service style easily on a par with some of the top restaurants that we eat in the Uk.

Now to those steaks. We expected the striploin and the blade to be thinly cut but these were full on pieces of meat worthy of being at least 8oz in weight. Both cooked to perfection (Medium Rare) as we had asked and presented beautifully on the plate with a selection of vegetables including my favourite Asparagus. Absolutely stunning!

After finishing our meals and wine we left feeling absolutely satisfied with both the food and the service.

I vowed I would put this place on the map on Trip Advisor to give other travellers the opportunity to sample what we had and this I have done with this first review for this stunning place and it’s excellent staff.

Very well done on introducing this lovely place to Nha Trang and we will be sure to visit a few more times before we return to the U.K. 

Jo and Martin Hull
